# Blade & Blend Studio

> Barbershop in Göteborg, Sweden. Book a haircut online with barbers Hassan, Victor or Salman. Located at Geijersgatan 10, 411 34 Göteborg. Open Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00, closed Sundays.

Blade & Blend Studio is a single-page barbershop website. A visitor picks a barber, chooses a day and time, selects a service, and books an appointment online. The site is bilingual (Swedish by default, English available) and adapts between an editorial desktop layout and a Material-style mobile layout. The public site is a single page; the only other routes are the staff login and admin panel.

## Services & pricing
- Herr (men's haircut) — Wednesday–Saturday and Monday–Tuesday tiers
- Studentrabatt (student discount) — Wednesdays only
- Barn (children up to 12 years)
- Price range: 200–450 kr (SEK)

## Contact
- Address: Geijersgatan 10, 411 34 Göteborg, Sweden
- Phone: +46 79 304 36 71
- Hours: Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00, Sun closed
- Barbers: Hassan, Victor, Salman
